text: @allmodels/dsh-speech 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的语音输入与语音摘要插件。它通过 Cordis 插件和浏览器模块接入，在聊天输入框旁提供麦克风、录音状态与设备选择，并在设置页提供语音识别和朗读选项。录音会被转换成实时音频帧并显示识别文本，用户可编辑后发送；助手完成一轮回答后，插件可按记录的模型路线生成简短摘要并合成语音播放。设置还包括识别语言、上下文提示、语音模型、声音和自动播放。插件使用 AllModels.io 的语音服务，需连接账户或配置 API 凭据；摘要生成调用 Harness 当前记录的 LLM 路线。

@allmodels/dsh-speech adds live speech input and spoken summaries to the Harness web client. Users edit transcripts from a chat microphone. Completed answers can be summarized and read aloud with configurable voices and autoplay. AllModels.io credentials power recognition and speech synthesis.
想边说话边把语音转成聊天输入文字。
DSH 网页聊天能加一个可选择麦克风的语音输入吗？
希望助手回答结束后自动念一段简短总结。
我想调整语音识别语言、模型和朗读声音。
Can I dictate a message into the Harness chat and edit the live transcript?
I want completed assistant answers summarized and read aloud in the browser.
@allmodels/dsh-speech 的功能「语音输入」：点击聊天框旁的麦克风开始录音，插件将音频帧送去识别并把结果放入可编辑草稿。
@allmodels/dsh-speech 的功能「朗读摘要」：助手完成一轮后生成回答摘要并合成语音，可播放或自动播放。
@allmodels/dsh-speech 的功能「语音设置」：在设置页连接服务并调整识别语言、上下文、语音模型、声音和自动播放。
@allmodels/dsh-speech 的功能「声音目录」：按模型、提供方、关键词或语言查询可用朗读声音并选择声音。
让语音输入替我写好对话草稿。
Choose a voice and play a spoken recap of the agent response.

@allmodels/dsh-speech README · @allmodels/dsh-speech：**The speech plugin DeepSeek Harness deserves.**

Talk to your coding agent, see your words appear in real time, and hear a concise spoken summary when the work is done. Powered by [AllModels.io](https://allmodels.io/).
@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Demo：https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a727afab-777d-487d-a145-175f5e570eca

@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @allmodels/dsh-speech
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness, then open **Settings → Speech**.

@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Connect AllModels：Enter your email address and AllModels will send you a sign-in code. New accounts get **$1 free credit**, which should last for plenty of hours of transcription and spoken summaries.

Already have an AllModels API key? You can use that instead.
@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Talk to your agent：Click the microphone next to Send and start talking. Your transcript appears as you speak, ready to edit or send.

@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Hear the summary：When the agent finishes, the plugin turns its final message into a short spoken summary. Enable autoplay to hear it immediately, or play it whenever you want.
@allmodels/dsh-speech README · Contributing：Development, testing, release, and compatibility-monitoring notes are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).
